text:
carla: Heads-up — Deploybot just paused promotion for `redwood/api:2026-03-18-rc3` to ECR (eu-west-1). It flagged a partial push and set quarantine=true.
carla: Error snippet from the registry agent:
```
Uploading layer 3/7...
UploadPart: MD5 mismatch
PutImage: layer missing after upload
cosign annotation check: kms-annotation mismatch (expected kms://projects/prod-key, got kms://projects/staging-key)
```
carla: CI shows the build completed but the registry lost a layer during multipart upload. Not sure if we should retag+retry, repush same build id, or pin back to the previous digest and rollback the canary. Any preferences?
deploybot: [deploybot]  -- image promotion halted by automatic checks. quarantine=true, canary aborted for this tag, promotion window locked. Suggested actions: hold, do not retag same tag, or republish under new tag.
ben: Hold promotion. Do not reuse the same tag without re-attestation. If CI can re-upload the same digest reliably, option A = republish artifacts with same build-id and re-run attestations. Option B (safer) = build->push->cosign sign again under a new tag (rc3-republish) and pin services to the previous stable digest until new image is verified.
mia: I can trigger a rebuild+push from CI, but note the cosign/KMS mismatch in the logs. That suggests the signing key used for this push might be different (staging vs prod). If we repush, we need the same signing key or we'll need a new attestation flow. Also avoid force-retagging the existing tag to a new digest.
lee: FYI — there was a 10% canary already in prod earlier today before the pause. If we leave the partial image in quarantine, we should immediately pin the canary hosts back to the previous digest to avoid serving from an incomplete image. Recommend: abort canary rollout, pin to last-good digest, then coordinate republish.
carla: Proposed step list: 1) abort canary (lee) 2) pin services to previous digest (ben/car la ops) 3) trigger CI republish under a new tag (mia) 4) run cosign attestation and deploybot validations (devops) 5) resume promotion once green. Sound ok?
ben: +1. Also log the incident in release notes: "staging push quarantined due to multipart upload failure; rollback to previous digest; republish scheduled."
carla: Commands we might run: 
```bash
# check current digests
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/api --image-ids imageTag=2026-03-18-rc3
# pin via deploybot CLI
deploybot pin service/api --digest sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6... --reason "quarantine after partial push"
```
deploybot: [deploybot]  -- sample pin command validated. To unfreeze promotion submit `deploybot unfreeze image redwood/api:2026-03-18-rc3 --by @ben` after re-attestation.
ci-bot: Rebuild triggered: https://ci.internal/builds/4829 — will push to `redwood/api:2026-03-18-rc3-republish` once artifacts are ready.
carla: I'll update the release-channel and post an incident note to #incidents. Leaving the window locked until CI confirms a successful republish + cosign attestation.
ben: If republish fails, fallback = pin to previous digest and schedule a maintenance window to re-run all canaries later.
mia: Starting republish now, will post logs here.
carla: Thanks — :thumbsup: keep messages short in this thread so the oncall can follow.
